# Refund Escalation Policy — Northwind Support

## Scope
This policy governs how a refund request is escalated when the first-line
support agent cannot approve it directly.

## Approval thresholds
A refund under $50 may be approved by any support agent. A refund between
$50 and $500 requires a team lead. Any refund above $500 requires the
regional operations manager and must be recorded in the audit trail before
the payment is released.

## Escalation path
1. The support agent records the refund reason on the case note.
2. If the amount exceeds the agent's threshold, the case is assigned to a
   team lead with the SLA clock paused.
3. The team lead either approves, rejects with a written reason, or escalates
   to the regional operations manager.
4. A refund above $500 is never released without a recorded human approval.

## SLA
A refund escalation must reach a decision within 24 business hours. Breaching
that window raises the case priority to high and notifies the operations lead.

## Related
See the request closure policy for what must be true before a refunded case
can be set to resolved.
